sprint.title: One Hop-Count-Agnostic Unambiguous Local Destination Route Resolver
sprint.goal: Derive one unique authored simple local route of any hop length for go to <location> and move to <location>, validate every hop before mutation, and compose immediate movement semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one eligible authored simple route of any hop length succeeds.
Zero or multiple routes fail without mutation and cycles terminate.
Immediate, two-hop, and three-hop behavior remains compatible.
Route data is derived and transient; save version remains 1.

focused_commands: Affected movement, navigation, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
Simple authored paths make cyclic traversal finite without hop limits or ranking.
No persistence, migration, parser expansion, route preference, or excluded system is permitted.
Provider requests are forbidden and next_sprint remains null.

closeout.verification_result: Official-interpreter preflight, syntax checks, focused hop-agnostic traversal coverage, affected navigation, save/load, one-hour West-Road traversal, narration-context, and fake-transport OpenAI Responses regressions passed.
